rawFindings.title: Only the first script placeholder is expanded
rawFindings.explanation: Passing the string '%' to mout.string.replace uses single-occurrence replacement, so hook commands with more than one package placeholder now leave later '%' characters unchanged. Previously the global regexp expanded every placeholder in the configured script command.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore a global replacement, e.g. `var cmdString = mout.string.replace(config.scripts[action], /%/g, orderedPackages.join(' '));`.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: With `config.scripts.preinstall` set to `touch preinstall_%_%` and one package `jquery`, the command becomes `touch preinstall_jquery_%` instead of `touch preinstall_jquery_jquery`, leaving the second placeholder unexpanded.
